Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 10. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 11. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 13. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 14. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 15. Certificates To be eligible for award of contract, Bidder / OEM must possess following Certificates / Test Reports on the date of bid opening (to be uploaded with bid): requred . 16. Warranty Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period: After having been notified of the defects / service requirement during warranty period, Seller has to complete the required Service / Rectification within 3 days time limit. If the Seller fails to complete service / rectification with defined time limit, a penalty of 0.5% of Unit Price of the product shall be charged as penalty for each week of delay from the seller. Seller can deposit the penalty with the Buyer directly else the Buyer shall have a right to recover all such penalty amount from the Performance Security (PBG).Cumulative Penalty cannot exceed more than 10% of the total contract value after which the Buyer shall have the right to get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the risk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of PBG. Seller shall be liable to re-imberse the cost of such service / rectification to the Buyer. 17. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

1. Scope of Work: The contractor shall undertake inspection, fault diagnosis, repair, servicing, testing and maintenance of the Speed Radar System, including all associated components, accessories, cables, power supply units, display units, sensors and software, as applicable. 2. Pre-Repair Inspection: The contractor shall inspect the complete system and submit a detailed technical inspection report identifying the defects, required repairs, replacement parts and estimated repair cost be fore commencing the repair work. 3. Approval Before Repair: No repair or replacement of any component shall be undertaken without prior w ritten approval from the competent authority. 4. Genuine Spare Parts: All spare parts and components used for repair shall be genuine, compatible with t he existing Speed Radar System and sourced from the OEM or its authorised supplier. 5. Technical Competency: The firm shall possess adequate technical expertise and experience in the repair and maintenance of Speed Radar Systems. The firm shall submit relevant experience certificates or satisfa ctory work completion certificates, wherever applicable. 6. On-Site Repair: The contractor shall preferably carry out repair and maintenance at the user's premises. If the equipment is required to be taken to the workshop, prior written permission shall be obtained from t he competent authority. 7. Transportation: The responsibility for safe packing, transportation, handling and return of equipment sh all rest with the contractor. No additional charges shall be payable unless specifically approved. 8. Repair Timeline: The contractor shall complete the repair work within 15 days from the date of approval of the repair estimate or placement of the repair order, as applicable. 9. Preventive Maintenance: The contractor shall carry out cleaning, inspection, calibration checks, function al testing and preventive maintenance of the complete system. 10. Testing and Demonstration: After completion of repairs, the contractor shall conduct comprehensive fu nctional testing and demonstrate the satisfactory working of the Speed Radar System in the presence of th e user's representative. 11. Calibration Certificate: The contractor shall provide a valid calibration certificate from a competent/aut horised calibration agency, wherever applicable, to ensure accuracy and reliability of speed measurement. 12. Warranty on Repairs: The contractor shall provide a minimum warranty of 06 months on all repaired/re placed parts and workmanship from the date of successful completion and acceptance of the repair work. 13. Defective Parts: All defective parts removed during repair shall be returned to the department along wi th the repaired equipment, unless otherwise directed by the competent authority. 14. No Additional Charges: No additional charges shall be payable for labour, servicing, installation, testing or other activities included in the approved scope of work. 15. Confidentiality and Security: The contractor and its technical personnel shall maintain strict confidentia lity regarding the equipment, its configuration, operational data and any information accessed during repai r and maintenance. 16. Non-Performance: In case the contractor fails to complete the repair within the stipulated period witho ut valid justification, the competent authority shall be entitled to take appropriate action as per the terms and conditions of the contract. 17. Payment Terms: Payment shall be released only after satisfactory completion of repair, successful dem onstration, submission of the repair report, warranty certificate and acceptance by the competent authorit y. 18. Right to Reject: The department reserves the right to reject unsatisfactory repair work or defective/repl aced components if the equipment does not perform as per the required technical specifications. 19. Inspection Rights: The department reserves the right to inspect the repair work and verify the quality a nd genuineness of spare parts at any stage. 20. Final Acceptance: Final acceptance of the repair work shall be subject to satisfactory functioning of the complete Speed Radar System and certification by the Board of Officers/authorised technical representativ e.
